lonlat_to_uv: u = (lon - west) / 48 ; v = (north - lat) / 18   (0..1, v down)
source: Sentinel-2 L2A COGs, AWS Open Data bucket sentinel-cogs (sentinel-s2-l2a-cogs), TCI 1/16 overview (~160 m) + SCL
season: June-August, years [2023, 2024, 2025] (mostly July-August; snowy Scandes tiles supplemented with late-July/August looks)

compositing.mask: SCL classes 0 (no data), 1 (saturated), 3 (cloud shadow), 8/9 (cloud medium/high), 10 (thin cirrus) removed; TCI no-data (0) removed
compositing.outlier_rejection: looks brighter than 1.35x+12 or darker than 0.55x-4 of the per-pixel clear median rejected (thin cloud / missed shadow) when >=3 clear looks
compositing.snow: where at least one clear snow-free look exists, snow-classified (SCL 11) looks are ignored -> late-summer look, glaciers kept
compositing.statistic: per-pixel median of remaining looks; fallback 25th percentile of all valid looks
compositing.tile_blend: reprojected (GDAL average) to the lat/lon grid with 24-px (~3.8 km) distance feathers; per-tile per-channel gains from least-squares on tile overlaps
compositing.water: sea = SCL-water connected to open sea (Natural Earth 1:10m land as seed) -> NASA Blue Marble ocean colour (three-globe earth-blue-marble.jpg, land-free inpainted ocean field, smoothed, cubic-upsampled); lakes keep Sentinel-2 texture toned toward deep navy; soft shorelines
compositing.grade: black point (7,11,6) TCI dehaze; luminance tone curve TCI [0,6,14,22,30,45,70,110,170,255] -> [0,4,22,42,58,84,117,151,192,238] applied hue-preserving; saturation x1.12; soft knee above 225; +-0.6 DN dither

known_limits: coastline and water detail limited to ~160 m source / 0.004 deg grid; skerries < ~300 m may be lost
bare rock / lichen plateaus (Jotunheimen, Finnmark, Varanger) are genuinely pale; perennial snow and glaciers remain white
ocean is Blue Marble (upsampled from 0.088 deg), intentionally smooth

recommended_use.globe_crossfade: the globe texture (globe_texture_8k.jpg) already contains this mosaic, softened over the outer ~1.6 deg of its border; when drawing this high-res patch over the globe, feather its alpha to 0 over the outer 1.2-1.6 deg (smoothstep of distance to the nearest edge) so the swap is invisible
recommended_use.aspect: plate carree: when framing Norway flat (2D), scale x by cos(64.5 deg) = 0.4305 (see preview_norway_1080p.png) or project on the globe

attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2023-2025. Ocean: NASA Blue Marble (via three-globe).
